name: io.github.mifsopo1/mifblender
title: MifBlender
description: AI in a running Blender: typed tools that read their result back, and each change is one undo step.

environmentVariables.name: MIF_BLENDER_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port the Blender add-on listens on (default 8792)

environmentVariables.name: MIF_BLENDER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Token shared with the add-on; written by 'uvx mifblender-mcp setup'

environmentVariables.name: MIF_TOOL_PACKS
environmentVariables.description: Tools to load: lean (default), blender (all), or a list of packs
